CA.rationale: A processing condition (command_estimate origin) is explicitly linked to the same candidate content referent.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified and the same referent has an explicit origin/status (organization/access) allowing separation of content and status.

A.rationale: A processing/command-derived origin is explicitly associated with the candidate content referent, linking a processing condition to that content's representation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify represented items (color-coded coordinates); this example shows an identified content and attribute.

D.rationale: Content identity (red coordinates) is presented separately from a status/organization field (origin) for the same referent.

O.rationale: The report states display layout explicitly and gives origin/access presentation metadata for content referents.
